Traffic Advisory 

On 27.01.2026, an official function will be held at Mahatma Gandhi Smrithi Sthal, Rajghat, which will be attended by many dignitaries.
 
Traffic may be diverted from the following points (On Need Basis): -
 
1. ITO Chowk
2. Delhi Gate
3. Guru Nanak Chowk
4. Shantivan Chowk
5. Rajghat DTC Depot
6. IP Flyover
 
Traffic Restrictions/ Diversions: -

Traffic restrictions/regulation/diversion may be imposed on following road/stretches and the surrounding roads/stretches on need basis on 27.01.2026 Timing 09.15 AM to 12:30 PM.

1. ITO Chowk to Delhi Gate on BSZ Marg.
2. Shanti Van Chowk till IP Flyover.
3. Asaf Ali Road - Delhi Gate to N.S. Marg
4. Shantivan Chowk to Nishad Raj Marg
5. Guru Nanak Chowk to Ranjeet Singh Flyover
6. Rajghat DTC Depot to Ring Road Bye Pass
 
Instructions to general public: -
 
1. Avail public transport to help decongestion of roads.
2. Park your vehicles only at designated parking lots.
3. Avoid roadside parking as it causes hindrance to normal flow traffic.
4. In case any unusual/unidentified object or person is noticed in suspicious circumstances, information should be given to the Police on 112.

#DPTrafficAdvisory

In connection with an official function at Mahatma Gandhi Smriti Sthal, Rajghat on 27.01.2026, to be attended by several dignitaries, traffic movement in and around Rajghat and adjoining areas may remain regulated and diverted for a brief period.

DATE: 27.01.2026
TIME: 09:15 AM to 12:30 PM

📍 DIVERSION POINTS (As & when required):
-ITO Chowk
-Delhi Gate
-Guru Nanak Chowk
-Shantivan Chowk
-Rajghat DTC Depot
-IP Flyover
📍 STRETCHES LIKELY TO BE AFFECTED:
-ITO Chowk to Delhi Gate on Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg
-Shantivan Chowk to IP Flyover
-Asaf Ali Road – Delhi Gate to N.S. Marg
-Shantivan Chowk to Nishad Raj Marg
-Guru Nanak Chowk to Ranjit Singh Flyover
